work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Brief III raises the marquisate of Trevignano to a principality for Count Cosimo Conti; LF569 ex- → LF575 hibuisse across provenance LF572; LF638 → LF644 across running title LF641; full decernentes, derogation and 23 January 1835 closing LF659–666. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF542–542; the source closing at LF659–666 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctum Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die vigesima tertia ianuarii mil- _lesimo octingentesimo trigesimo quinto, ponti- ficatus Nostri anno quarto. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
